entry.title: Sol Next v9.1.2-public (Build 912) — Material 3 Dual-Mode, On-Device 4-Stage Realtime Voice, Built-In Brave Search & Hands-Free Notification Readout
entry.summary: Full native Material 3 Light/Dark dual-mode UI (Chat | Task), built-in DeepSeek Flash & Brave Search real-time web grounding, bundled 4-stage on-device realtime neural voice (GTCRN + Silero VAD v5 + Zipformer-CTC + AISHELL-3 VITS) for Live Voice & AI Phone Calls, hands-free driving Notification Voice Readout with Audio Ducking & OTP redaction, universal free login, Subscription OAuth model login, and OEM Accessibility self-healing.
